story: After murdering Emperor Zhaozong in 904, Zhu Wen ruled through the boy emperor Ai. In the spring of 907 he had the boy abdicate in his favour. Zhu Wen took the name Emperor Taizu of the Later Liang and made his old base, Bianzhou, renamed Kaifeng, his eastern capital. The last Tang emperor was poisoned the next year.

Much of the old empire refused to accept the new dynasty. Li Keyong in Taiyuan, the Prince of Jin, kept using the Tang reign title and fought on. Yang Wo's state of Wu held the lower Yangtze, Li Maozhen ruled Qi in the west, and Wang Jian in Sichuan declared himself emperor of Shu within months. China split into rival states for more than half a century.
story_zh: 904年杀害唐昭宗后，朱温通过年幼的唐哀帝控制朝政。907年春，他逼迫哀帝把皇位禅让给自己，建立后梁，是为后梁太祖，并把自己的老根据地汴州升为开封府，作为东都。第二年，唐朝末代皇帝被毒死。
原来唐朝的许多地方都不承认这个新王朝。太原的晋王李克用继续沿用唐朝年号，与后梁对抗到底；杨渥的吴国占据长江下游，李茂贞在西边统治岐国，四川的王建几个月后也称帝建立蜀国。此后半个多世纪，中国陷入列国并立的局面。
end-of-tang.why: The end of the Tang began the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms, a time of military rule in the north and steady growth in the south.
end-of-tang.why_zh: 唐朝的灭亡开启了五代十国时期：北方由武人轮番掌权，南方则相对稳定地发展。

people.name: Li Keyong
people.role: Prince of Jin, Zhu Wen's rival

story: Yelü Abaoji of the Yila tribe was chosen as khagan of the Khitan confederation in 907. By custom the post rotated among leading families, but Abaoji refused to give it up. His own brothers rebelled against him several times between 911 and 913, and he crushed them.

In 916 he declared himself emperor in the Chinese style, with a reign title and his eldest son as crown prince. With Chinese advisers he built walled towns for captured farmers and craftsmen and, from 918, a capital at Linhuang, later called the Supreme Capital. His wife, Empress Shulü Ping, was a powerful partner in government.
He went on to create a Khitan script in 920 and to conquer Balhae in 926.
story_zh: 耶律阿保机出身迭剌部，907年被推举为契丹联盟的可汗。按照惯例，可汗之位由几个大家族轮流担任，阿保机却拒绝交出权力。911年至913年间，他的几个弟弟多次叛乱，都被他镇压下去。
916年，阿保机仿照中原制度称帝，建立年号，立长子为太子。他在汉人谋士的帮助下，为被俘的农民和工匠修建城镇，从918年起又营建都城临潢，即后来的上京。他的妻子述律平皇后也是他治国的得力伙伴。
此后他在920年创制契丹文字，926年灭渤海。
abaoji.why: Abaoji turned a tribal confederation into a dynastic state that ruled northern China's frontier for two centuries.
abaoji.why_zh: 阿保机把一个部落联盟变成了世袭王朝，此后两百年间统治着中国北方边疆。

story: Li Cunxu inherited the state of Jin from his father Li Keyong in 908 and fought the Later Liang for fifteen years along the Yellow River. In the spring of 923 he proclaimed himself emperor at Weizhou, calling his dynasty Tang to claim the old dynasty's legacy.

Liang still had a large army, but in the autumn Li Cunxu took a bold gamble. Urged on by his generals Li Siyuan and Guo Chongtao, he sent a fast force straight at Kaifeng while the main Liang army was elsewhere. The Liang emperor Zhu Youzhen, with no troops to defend the city, ordered an officer to kill him. Kaifeng surrendered and the Later Liang ended.
Li Cunxu made Luoyang his capital.
story_zh: 908年，李存勖从父亲李克用手中接过晋国，此后沿黄河与后梁苦战了十五年。923年春，他在魏州称帝，以“唐”为国号，表明自己继承唐朝的正统。
后梁仍有大军，但这年秋天李存勖孤注一掷，采纳李嗣源、郭崇韬等将领的建议，趁后梁主力在外，派精兵直扑开封。后梁末帝朱友贞无兵守城，命部将把自己杀死。开封投降，后梁灭亡。
李存勖随后定都洛阳。
later-tang.why: It was the first of three dynasties founded by the Shatuo Turks, and it briefly united most of northern China.
later-tang.why_zh: 后唐是沙陀人建立的三个王朝中的第一个，一度统一了北方大部分地区。

story: The Former Shu in Sichuan had been founded by Wang Jian. His son Wang Yan, who came to the throne in 918, was more interested in feasts, travel and palaces than government. In the autumn of 925 Emperor Zhuangzong sent an army of about 60,000 under his son Li Jiji, with the able Guo Chongtao in real command.
Shu's defences collapsed. Many commanders surrendered without fighting, and Wang Yan gave himself up at Chengdu about seventy days after the campaign began.

The victory soon turned sour. Wang Yan and his family were killed on the way to Luoyang in 926. Court rumours turned Zhuangzong against Guo Chongtao, who was murdered in Chengdu on the empress's orders, and the army began to mutiny.
story_zh: 四川的前蜀由王建建立。918年继位的儿子王衍热衷于宴饮、游玩和修建宫殿，无心治国。925年秋，后唐庄宗派儿子李继岌率约六万大军伐蜀，实际指挥的是能干的郭崇韬。
前蜀防线全线崩溃，许多将领不战而降。出兵约七十天后，王衍在成都投降。
胜利很快变了味。926年，王衍一家在前往洛阳途中被杀。庄宗听信宫中谗言，对郭崇韬起了疑心，刘皇后下令在成都将他杀害，军中随即开始哗变。
shu-conquered.why: The easy conquest showed Later Tang's strength, but the killing of Guo Chongtao helped bring Zhuangzong down the next year.
shu-conquered.why_zh: 这次轻松的征服显示了后唐的实力，但郭崇韬被杀，也促成了庄宗次年的覆灭。

people.name: Li Jiji
people.role_zh: 庄宗之子，名义上的统帅

story: Balhae had ruled Manchuria and northern Korea for more than two centuries and was known to the Tang as a 'flourishing land in the east'. At the end of 925 Abaoji led a Khitan army against it. Early in 926 he took the fortress of Buyeo and then besieged the capital, Holhan city.

King Dae Inseon surrendered within days. Abaoji renamed the country Dongdan, the 'eastern Khitan', and put his eldest son Yelü Bei in charge as its king. Abaoji fell ill and died on the way home that summer.
Revolts continued for years. Many Balhae people fled to Goryeo in Korea, and in 928 the Khitan moved much of the population west to the Liao River area.
story_zh: 渤海国统治东北和朝鲜半岛北部二百多年，被唐朝称为“海东盛国”。925年底，阿保机率契丹大军讨伐渤海。926年初，他攻下扶余城，接着包围了都城忽汗城。
渤海末王大諲譔几天后就投降了。阿保机把渤海改名为东丹国，意思是“东方的契丹”，让长子耶律倍做东丹王。这年夏天，阿保机在归途中病逝。
此后多年，渤海故地反抗不断。许多渤海人逃往朝鲜半岛的高丽，928年契丹又把大批渤海居民迁到辽河一带。
balhae-falls.why: The conquest doubled the Khitan state's lands and population and secured its rear before it turned south toward China.
balhae-falls.why_zh: 灭渤海使契丹的疆域和人口大增，也稳住了后方，让它可以放手南下。

story: Meng Zhixiang, who was married to a niece of Li Keyong, was sent to govern western Sichuan after the conquest of Former Shu in 926. When Zhuangzong was killed later that year, Meng began building his own power. He quarrelled with the court and with Dong Zhang, governor of eastern Sichuan, and in 932 defeated Dong and took his lands.
Early in 934, as the Later Tang fell into a succession crisis, Meng declared himself emperor of Shu at Chengdu. He died a few months later, and his son Meng Chang ruled for over thirty years.
Protected by mountains, Sichuan stayed peaceful while the north was at war. Chengdu became a centre of printing, painting and poetry.
story_zh: 孟知祥娶了晋王李克用的侄女，926年平定前蜀后被派去镇守西川。同年庄宗被杀，孟知祥开始培植自己的势力。他与朝廷不和，又与东川节度使董璋争斗，932年击败董璋，吞并了东川。
934年初，后唐陷入皇位之争，孟知祥趁机在成都称帝，国号蜀。几个月后他就去世了，儿子孟昶在位三十多年。
有群山屏障，四川在北方战乱时保持了安定，成都成为印刷、绘画和诗词的中心。
later-shu.why: Later Shu preserved Sichuan's prosperity and culture until it surrendered to the Song in 965.
later-shu.why_zh: 后蜀保住了四川的富庶和文化，直到965年投降宋朝。

story: Shi Jingtang, a Shatuo general and son-in-law of the Later Tang emperor Mingzong, governed Hedong from Taiyuan. In 936 the new emperor Li Congke tried to transfer him, and Shi rebelled. When imperial armies besieged Taiyuan, he and his adviser Sang Weihan turned to the Khitan emperor Yelü Deguang.

Shi offered to call himself Deguang's son, though he was ten years older, to send 300,000 bolts of silk a year, and to hand over sixteen prefectures in the north, from Youzhou (Beijing) west to Yunzhou (Datong). Deguang came south with his cavalry, broke the siege and named Shi emperor of a new Jin dynasty. Luoyang fell weeks later, and Li Congke burned himself to death with his family.
story_zh: 沙陀将领石敬瑭是后唐明宗的女婿，坐镇太原，统治河东。936年，新皇帝李从珂要把他调离，石敬瑭随即起兵反叛。官军包围太原，他和谋士桑维翰向契丹皇帝耶律德光求援。
石敬瑭答应向比自己小十岁的耶律德光称儿，每年送绢三十万匹，并割让北方十六个州，东起幽州（今北京），西到云州（今大同）。耶律德光率骑兵南下解了太原之围，册立石敬瑭为皇帝，国号晋。几周后洛阳陷落，李从珂与家人自焚而死。
sixteen-prefectures.why: Losing the passes north of Beijing left the North China Plain open to horsemen from the steppe; no Chinese dynasty held them again until the Ming in 1368.
sixteen-prefectures.why_zh: 失去北京以北的关隘，华北平原便门户大开，任由草原骑兵长驱直入；直到1368年明朝建立，中原王朝才重新控制这一地区。

story: The state of Wu on the lower Yangtze had been run for years by the regent Xu Wen while the Yang family kept the throne. After Xu Wen died in 927, his adopted son Xu Zhigao took over. In 937 the last Wu ruler, Yang Pu, abdicated in his favour, and Xu Zhigao became emperor at Jinling (Nanjing).

In 939 he changed his name to Li Bian and renamed his state Tang, claiming descent from the Tang imperial family. Historians call it the Southern Tang. Li Bian kept peace with his neighbours, cut taxes and encouraged farming and learning. His successors were less cautious: his son Li Jing expanded into Min and Chu, and his grandson Li Yu was a great poet but a weak ruler.
story_zh: 长江下游的吴国，多年来由执政大臣徐温掌握实权，杨氏只保留着王位。927年徐温去世，养子徐知诰接掌大权。937年，吴国末代君主杨溥把王位禅让给他，徐知诰在金陵（今南京）称帝。
939年，他改名李昪，并改国号为唐，自称唐朝皇室后裔，史称南唐。李昪与邻国和睦相处，减轻赋税，鼓励农耕和文教。他的后代就没那么谨慎了：儿子李璟向闽、楚扩张，孙子李煜是一位大词人，却是个软弱的君主。
southern-tang.why: Southern Tang was the richest and most cultured of the southern states, famous for its painting, poetry and fine paper and ink.
southern-tang.why_zh: 南唐是南方诸国中最富庶、文化最繁荣的一个，以绘画、诗词以及精良的纸墨闻名。

people.name: Xu Wen
people.role: Regent of Wu, his adoptive father

story: Northern Vietnam, then called Jiaozhou or Annam, had been ruled from China for about a thousand years, but local leaders had taken control as the Tang collapsed. In 937 the local governor Dương Đình Nghệ was murdered by Kiều Công Tiễn, who asked the Southern Han in Guangzhou for support. Dương's son-in-law Ngô Quyền killed Kiều and prepared to meet the Southern Han.

The Southern Han emperor sent a fleet under his son Liu Hongcao. Ngô Quyền had his men drive iron-tipped wooden stakes into the bed of the Bạch Đằng River near its mouth. At high tide his small boats lured the enemy fleet in. When the tide went out, the heavy ships were caught on the stakes and destroyed. Liu Hongcao was killed.
story_zh: 越南北部当时称交州或安南，大约一千年来一直受中国王朝统治，唐朝衰亡时已由当地豪强掌握实权。937年，当地的节度使杨廷艺被矫公羡杀害，矫公羡向广州的南汉求援。杨廷艺的女婿吴权杀死矫公羡，准备迎战南汉。
南汉皇帝派儿子刘弘操率水军前来。吴权命人在白藤江入海口附近的江底打下包铁的木桩。涨潮时，他用小船把敌军船队引入江中；潮水退去后，南汉的大船被木桩卡住，全军覆没，刘弘操战死。
bach-dang.why: Ngô Quyền declared himself king in 939, and the battle is remembered as the start of Vietnam's lasting independence.
bach-dang.why_zh: 吴权于939年称王，这场战役被视为越南长期独立的开端。

people.name: Kiều Công Tiễn
people.role: Usurper who called in Southern Han

story: The Min kingdom in Fujian was founded by Wang Shenzhi, who ruled well from 909 to 925 and built up Fuzhou and the port of Quanzhou. After his death his sons and grandsons fought among themselves. In the 940s two brothers, Wang Yanxi in Fuzhou and Wang Yanzheng in Jianzhou, waged open civil war.

In 944 Wang Yanxi was murdered by his own officers. Southern Tang seized the chance, and in 945 its army took Jianzhou and captured Wang Yanzheng, ending the Wang dynasty. The Fuzhou commander Li Renda then switched sides and appealed to Wuyue, which sent troops by sea and took Fuzhou in 947. Quanzhou and Zhangzhou went their own way under local strongmen.
story_zh: 福建的闽国由王审知建立。他在909年至925年间治理有方，发展了福州和泉州港。他死后，子孙之间争斗不休。到940年代，福州的王延羲与建州的王延政兄弟俩爆发了公开内战。
944年，王延羲被部将杀死。南唐乘机出兵，945年攻下建州，俘获王延政，王氏政权就此灭亡。随后福州守将李仁达倒戈，向吴越求援，吴越从海路出兵，947年占领福州。泉州和漳州则由当地豪强自成一体。
min-divided.why: Fujian was split for decades, and Southern Tang's costly war there weakened it before Later Zhou attacked.
min-divided.why_zh: 此后几十年福建四分五裂；南唐在这里耗费巨大，国力也因此在后周来攻之前就已受损。

story: Shi Jingtang's successor, Shi Chonggui, refused to call himself the Khitan emperor's vassal. War followed from 944. At first the Jin armies held their own, but in the winter of 946 their commander Du Chongwei surrendered his whole army, hoping to be made emperor himself.

Early in 947 Yelü Deguang entered Kaifeng and sent Shi Chonggui into exile in the north. He held court in Chinese style and named his dynasty Great Liao. But he did not pay his troops, who lived by plundering the countryside, and revolts broke out everywhere. In the spring Deguang withdrew north, carrying off officials, craftsmen and treasures. He fell ill and died on the way.
story_zh: 石敬瑭的继承人石重贵不肯向契丹称臣，944年起双方开战。起初后晋军队还能抵挡，但946年冬，统帅杜重威想自己当皇帝，竟率全军投降。
947年初，耶律德光进入开封，把石重贵流放到北方。他按中原礼仪临朝，定国号为大辽。但他不给军队发饷，任由士兵四处劫掠，即所谓“打草谷”，各地纷纷起兵反抗。这年春天，耶律德光带着掳来的官员、工匠和财宝北撤，途中病死。
liao-takes-kaifeng.why: The Liao learned it could not rule the Chinese heartland directly, and settled for holding the Sixteen Prefectures.
liao-takes-kaifeng.why_zh: 辽朝从中认识到无法直接统治中原腹地，此后满足于控制燕云十六州。

quote.zh: 我不知中国之人难制如此！
quote.en: I did not know that the people of China were so hard to control!
quote.from: Yelü Deguang, recorded in the Zizhi Tongjian 耶律德光语，见《资治通鉴》

story: Liu Zhiyuan, a Shatuo general, governed Hedong from Taiyuan and kept his army intact while the Later Jin fell. In early 947, as the Khitan occupation provoked revolts, he declared himself emperor, at first even keeping the Later Jin reign title.
When Yelü Deguang withdrew, Liu marched south, entered Kaifeng in the summer and named his dynasty Han. He died early the next year.

His young son Liu Chengyou resented the senior ministers who ran the government. In 950 he had several of them killed, along with the family of the general Guo Wei, who was away defending the northern frontier. Guo Wei's army marched on Kaifeng, Liu Chengyou was killed in the fighting, and the dynasty ended after four years.
story_zh: 沙陀将领刘知远坐镇太原，统治河东，在后晋灭亡时保全了自己的兵力。947年初，契丹的占领激起各地反抗，他趁机称帝，起初甚至沿用后晋的年号。
耶律德光北撤后，刘知远率军南下，夏天进入开封，定国号为汉。第二年初他就去世了。
他年轻的儿子刘承祐不满执政的老臣，950年杀了其中几位，还把在北方守边的大将郭威一家满门抄斩。郭威率军杀回开封，刘承祐死于乱军之中，后汉仅存在了四年就灭亡了。
later-han.why: Later Han was the shortest of the Five Dynasties, and its fall brought Guo Wei and the reforming Later Zhou to power.
later-han.why_zh: 后汉是五代中最短命的王朝，它的灭亡使郭威和锐意改革的后周登上历史舞台。

story: After his family was murdered, Guo Wei led his army from Yedu to Kaifeng at the end of 950. The emperor was killed, and Guo's troops plundered the capital. Guo Wei set out north again, supposedly to face the Khitan, but at Chanzhou his soldiers tore up a yellow flag, wrapped it around him and hailed him as emperor. He returned to Kaifeng and founded the Zhou dynasty early in 951.

Guo Wei had grown up poor. He cut taxes, ended some of the harshest punishments and reduced palace spending. Liu Zhiyuan's brother Liu Chong, who held Taiyuan, refused to submit and set up the Northern Han with Liao support.
Guo Wei died in 954 and was succeeded by his adopted son, Chai Rong.
story_zh: 家人被杀后，郭威于950年底率军从邺都杀向开封，后汉皇帝被杀，郭威的士兵在京城大肆抢掠。随后郭威借口抵御契丹再次北上，到了澶州，士兵们撕下黄旗披在他身上，拥立他为皇帝。他回到开封，于951年初建立周朝。
郭威出身贫寒，即位后减轻赋税，废除了一些最残酷的刑罚，削减宫廷开支。占据太原的刘知远之弟刘崇拒不归顺，在辽朝支持下建立了北汉。
954年郭威去世，养子柴荣继位。
later-zhou.why: Later Zhou's reforms laid the foundations on which the Song reunified China.
later-zhou.why_zh: 后周的改革为宋朝统一中国打下了基础。

story: The kingdom of Chu in Hunan was founded by Ma Yin, a former carpenter turned soldier, who ruled it peacefully and grew rich from the tea trade. After 947 his sons fought over the throne. Ma Xi'e, with help from the local Man peoples, took Changsha from his brother Ma Xiguang in 950 and had him killed, but he ruled badly.

In 951 Ma Xi'e's own officers deposed him, and both factions asked Southern Tang for help. A Southern Tang army under Bian Hao marched in, took Changsha and moved the whole Ma family to Jinling. Southern Han took the opportunity to seize Chu's lands in Guangxi.
In 952 Hunan generals led by Liu Yan rose, drove out the Southern Tang troops and ruled the region themselves.
story_zh: 湖南的楚国由马殷建立。马殷木匠出身，后来从军，他统治期间湖南安定，靠茶叶贸易致富。947年后，他的儿子们争夺王位。马希萼借助当地蛮族的力量，于950年从弟弟马希广手中夺取长沙，并杀了马希广，但他的统治十分糟糕。
951年，马希萼被部将废黜，双方都向南唐求援。南唐派边镐率军进入湖南，占领长沙，把马氏全族迁到金陵。南汉乘机夺取了楚国在广西的土地。
952年，以刘言为首的湖南将领起兵，赶走了南唐军队，由他们自己统治湖南。
chu-falls.why: Chu's fall showed how fragile the southern kingdoms were, and the failure in Hunan cost Southern Tang men and money.
chu-falls.why_zh: 楚国的灭亡说明南方诸国十分脆弱，而在湖南的失败也让南唐损兵折财。

people.name: Liu Yan
people.role: Hunan general who expelled Southern Tang

story: When Guo Wei died early in 954, Liu Chong of Northern Han saw his chance. With Liao cavalry he invaded from Taiyuan. The new emperor, Chai Rong, decided to lead the army himself, even though the veteran minister Feng Dao argued against it.

The armies met near Gaoping in southern Shanxi. When the fighting began, the commanders of Zhou's right wing, Fan Ai'neng and He Hui, fled with their cavalry. Chai Rong rode into the battle himself, and his guards, including a young officer named Zhao Kuangyin, charged and broke the Northern Han line. The Liao troops withdrew without fighting.
Afterwards Chai Rong executed the two generals and more than seventy officers who had fled, and rebuilt his palace army.
story_zh: 954年初郭威去世，北汉刘崇认为有机可乘，联合辽朝骑兵从太原南犯。新即位的柴荣决定御驾亲征，尽管老臣冯道极力劝阻。
两军在今山西南部的高平附近相遇。交战刚开始，后周右翼的樊爱能、何徽两员将领就带着骑兵逃跑了。柴荣亲自冒着箭矢督战，禁军将士奋勇冲锋，其中就有年轻的军官赵匡胤，一举冲垮了北汉军阵。辽军见势不妙，不战而退。
战后，柴荣斩了樊爱能、何徽以及七十多名临阵脱逃的军官，并整顿扩充了禁军。
gaoping.why: The victory secured Chai Rong's throne, gave him a disciplined army, and launched the career of the future founder of Song.
gaoping.why_zh: 这场胜利巩固了柴荣的皇位，使他拥有了一支纪律严明的军队，也让未来的宋朝开国皇帝崭露头角。

story: Chai Rong planned to unite China by taking the rich south first. At the end of 955 he sent an army against Southern Tang's lands between the Huai and the Yangtze, and in 956 he went to the front himself.

The key was Shouzhou on the Huai, defended by the Southern Tang general Liu Renshan. He held out for more than a year, until he fell gravely ill in 957 and his officers surrendered. Chai Rong built a river fleet so his northern army could fight on the water, and in 958 his forces reached the Yangtze.
The Southern Tang ruler Li Jing gave up all fourteen prefectures north of the river, dropped the title of emperor and accepted the Zhou calendar as a sign of submission.
story_zh: 柴荣计划先取富庶的南方，再统一全国。955年底，他派兵进攻南唐在淮河与长江之间的土地，956年又亲临前线。
关键在淮河边的寿州。南唐守将刘仁赡坚守了一年多，直到957年身患重病，部下才开城投降。柴荣建立了一支水军，让北方军队能够在水上作战。958年，后周军队打到长江边。
南唐国主李璟割让长江以北全部十四个州，去掉帝号，改用后周的年号历法，以示臣服。
huainan-campaign.why: Taking the lands north of the Yangtze gave the northern state the salt and grain of the Huai region and left Southern Tang open to conquest.
huainan-campaign.why_zh: 夺取江北之地，使北方政权获得了淮南的盐和粮食，南唐从此门户洞开。

story: Qian Liu, a former salt smuggler, rose to command the region around Hangzhou during the last years of the Tang and was named King of Wuyue in 907. His capital lay beside the Qiantang River, where a powerful tidal bore regularly broke through the earth embankments and flooded fields with salt water.

In 910 he ordered a new seawall. Workers filled long bamboo cages with stones, laid them in layers along the shore and fixed them with rows of wooden piles driven deep into the mud. Later legend says that Qian Liu had archers shoot arrows at the tide to drive it back while the work went on.
The wall protected the city and the surrounding farmland, and Hangzhou began to grow into one of the great cities of China.
story_zh: 钱镠早年贩过私盐，唐朝末年逐渐掌握了杭州一带的军政大权，907年被封为吴越王。他的都城紧靠钱塘江，汹涌的江潮常常冲垮土堤，海水倒灌淹没农田。
910年，他下令修筑新的海塘。民工把石块装进长长的竹笼，沿岸层层堆砌，再在外侧打下深入泥中的成排木桩加以固定。后世传说，施工期间钱镠命弓箭手向潮头放箭，把潮水逼退，这就是“钱王射潮”的故事。
海塘保护了杭州城和周边农田，杭州从此逐渐发展为中国的大都会之一。
qian-liu-seawall.why: The seawall helped make Wuyue one of the most prosperous of the Ten Kingdoms and laid the ground for Hangzhou's later role as Southern Song capital.
qian-liu-seawall.why_zh: 捍海石塘使吴越成为十国中最富庶的国家之一，也为杭州后来成为南宋都城打下了基础。

story: At the end of the Tang, Liu Yin, a military officer whose family had come south generations earlier, took control of Guangzhou and the Lingnan region. When he died in 911 his younger brother Liu Yan succeeded him.

In 917 Liu Yan declared himself emperor at Guangzhou, which he renamed Xingwang. He called his state Great Yue at first and changed the name to Han the next year; historians call it the Southern Han. The state grew rich from the sea trade with Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean, and its rulers built lavish palaces.
Southern Han was also notorious for cruel punishments and, under its later rulers, for the enormous power of palace eunuchs. Song conquered it in 971.
story_zh: 唐朝末年，祖上早年南迁的军官刘隐控制了广州和岭南地区。911年刘隐去世，弟弟刘䶮继承了他的地位。
917年，刘䶮在广州称帝，改广州为兴王府，国号起初为大越，第二年改为汉，史称南汉。南汉靠与东南亚和印度洋的海上贸易致富，历代君主大修豪华宫殿。
南汉也以刑罚残酷著称，后期宦官势力极大。971年，南汉被宋朝灭亡。
southern-han-founded.why: Southern Han kept Guangzhou's sea trade going through the period of division and tried to keep northern Vietnam under its control until its defeat at Bạch Đằng.
southern-han-founded.why_zh: 在分裂时期，南汉维持了广州的海上贸易，并试图控制越南北部，直到在白藤江之战中失败。

story: As the Khitan state grew, Abaoji needed a way to write his own people's language, which was not related to Chinese. In 920 he ordered a new script, and the officials Yelü Tulübu and Yelü Lubugu created it. Known as the Khitan large script, it used characters shaped like Chinese ones, many borrowed directly, to write Khitan words.
A few years later Abaoji's brother Yelü Diela, who had learned the Uyghur language, devised a second system, the Khitan small script, which partly spelled words by sound.
Both scripts were used for official inscriptions, tombstones and seals throughout the Liao and into the Jin dynasty, until they were banned in 1191. Today they are still only partly deciphered.
story_zh: 随着契丹国家的发展，阿保机需要一种书写本族语言的文字，而契丹语与汉语并不同源。920年，他下令创制文字，由耶律突吕不和耶律鲁不古完成。这种文字后来称为契丹大字，字形与汉字相似，不少字直接借自汉字，用来书写契丹语。
几年后，阿保机的弟弟、懂得回鹘语的耶律迭剌又创制了另一套文字，即契丹小字，部分采用拼音方式。
这两种文字在整个辽代乃至金代都用于官方碑刻、墓志和印章，直到1191年才被废止。时至今日，它们仍只被部分破译。
khitan-script.why: The Khitan scripts were the first of several scripts made by northern peoples on Chinese models, followed by Tangut and Jurchen.
khitan-script.why_zh: 契丹文字是北方民族仿照汉字创制的第一种文字，此后又出现了西夏文和女真文。

people.name: Yelü Abaoji
people.role: Khitan emperor who ordered the script
people.role_zh: 下令创制文字的契丹皇帝

story: After destroying the Later Liang in 923, Li Cunxu, Emperor Zhuangzong, lost interest in government. He loved the theatre, performed on stage under the name Li Tianxia, and gave offices to actors. His Empress Liu hoarded money while the soldiers went unpaid in a year of famine. In 926 he had his best general, Guo Chongtao, killed on false suspicions.

That spring troops at Yedu mutinied. Zhuangzong sent his adoptive brother Li Siyuan against them, but the soldiers made Li Siyuan their leader instead. As Li Siyuan marched toward the capital, Guo Congqian, an actor turned officer, led an uprising in Luoyang. Zhuangzong was hit by an arrow while fighting at the palace gate and died. Li Siyuan entered the city and became emperor, known as Mingzong.
story_zh: 923年灭掉后梁后，后唐庄宗李存勖就无心理政。他酷爱戏曲，常以“李天下”的艺名登台演出，还给伶人封官。荒年时士兵领不到军饷，刘皇后却一味聚敛钱财。926年，庄宗又听信谗言，杀了最得力的大将郭崇韬。
这年春天，邺都驻军哗变。庄宗派义兄李嗣源前去平叛，士兵们却拥立李嗣源为首领。李嗣源向京城进军之际，由伶人提拔为将领的郭从谦在洛阳发动兵变。庄宗在宫门前作战时中箭身亡。李嗣源进入洛阳称帝，是为后唐明宗。
zhuangzong-killed.why: Zhuangzong's fall became a classic lesson in how success breeds ruin, retold by Ouyang Xiu in the New History of the Five Dynasties.
zhuangzong-killed.why_zh: 庄宗的覆灭成为“成于忧患、败于安乐”的经典教训，欧阳修在《新五代史》中专门作了评述。

people.name: Guo Congqian
people.role_zh: 发动兵变的伶人出身将领

quote.zh: 忧劳可以兴国，逸豫可以亡身。
quote.en: Worry and toil can raise up a state; ease and pleasure can destroy a man.
quote.from: Ouyang Xiu, preface to the Biographies of Actors 欧阳修《五代史伶官传序》

story: Woodblock printing was already used for Buddhist texts, calendars and dictionaries, but the Confucian classics were still copied by hand or rubbed from stone inscriptions. In 932 the chancellors Feng Dao and Li Yu proposed to Emperor Mingzong of Later Tang that the Directorate of Education print the classics, using the authoritative text carved in stone at Chang'an in the 830s.

Scholars checked the text, calligraphers wrote it out and craftsmen carved the blocks. The work went on through the Later Tang, Later Jin, Later Han and Later Zhou, moving from Luoyang to Kaifeng. It was completed in 953, in 130 volumes.
Feng Dao, who served ten emperors of several dynasties, was later scorned for his lack of loyalty, but this project is remembered to his credit.
story_zh: 当时雕版印刷已经用于佛经、历书和字书，但儒家经典仍靠手抄或从石经上拓印。932年，宰相冯道和李愚向后唐明宗建议，由国子监依照唐朝830年代在长安刻成的石经文本，雕版印刷儒家经典。
学者校订文字，书法家誊写，工匠刻版。工程历经后唐、后晋、后汉、后周四朝，地点也从洛阳移到开封，直到953年才全部完成，共一百三十册。
冯道先后侍奉多个朝代的十位皇帝，后世常讥讽他不讲忠节，但这项工程一直被记作他的功劳。
nine-classics-printed.why: Government printing of the classics made accurate texts cheap and widely available, preparing the way for the book culture of the Song.
nine-classics-printed.why_zh: 官方刻印经书，使准确的经典文本变得便宜易得，为宋代书籍文化的繁荣铺平了道路。

story: By the 950s many people became monks or nuns to escape taxes and military service, and the state was short of bronze for coins. In 955 Chai Rong ordered that only monasteries holding an official name plaque could remain. About 30,000 were closed and some 2,700 kept, and new rules limited who could be ordained.

The same year the emperor ordered that bronze Buddhist statues and ritual objects, along with private bronze vessels, be handed over and melted down to cast coins. When officials worried about offending the Buddha, he replied that the Buddha had given his body to help others and would not mind giving up a statue.
Unlike the earlier persecutions, monks were not forced back to lay life in huge numbers, and Buddhism itself was not banned.
story_zh: 到950年代，许多人为了逃避赋税和兵役而出家，国家铸钱又缺少铜料。955年，柴荣下令：只有朝廷颁赐过寺额的寺院才能保留。全国废除寺院约三万所，保留约两千七百所，并对出家资格作了严格限制。
同年，他又下令收缴铜佛像、法器以及民间铜器，熔化铸钱。有大臣担心冒犯佛祖，柴荣回答说，佛以身体布施众生，如果真身尚在且有利于世人，也会毫不吝惜，何况一尊铜像。
与以往几次灭佛不同，这次并没有强迫大批僧尼还俗，也没有禁止佛教本身。
shizong-buddhism.why: The measures strengthened Later Zhou's finances and army for reunification; Chinese Buddhist tradition counts it as the last of the 'three Wus and one Zong' persecutions.
shizong-buddhism.why_zh: 这些措施充实了后周的财政和军力，为统一做好了准备；佛教史上把它列为“三武一宗”法难中的最后一次。

story: Wang Jian came from a poor family in Henan and had been a petty thief and smuggler before joining the Tang army. In the 880s he served among the guards of Emperor Xizong, and by 891 he had made himself master of Chengdu. Over the next decade he took control of almost all of Sichuan.
When Zhu Wen ended the Tang in 907, Wang Jian refused to accept the new Liang dynasty. That autumn he declared himself emperor of Great Shu at Chengdu. Historians call it the Former Shu.

Sichuan was peaceful and prosperous, and many officials and scholars from the north came to serve Wang Jian, including the poet Wei Zhuang, who became his chancellor. Wang Jian's tomb still stands in Chengdu.
story_zh: 王建出身河南贫寒人家，从军之前做过小偷和私盐贩子。880年代，他曾在唐僖宗身边担任护卫，到891年已经控制了成都。此后十年间，他几乎占据了整个四川。
907年朱温灭唐，王建拒不承认后梁。这年秋天，他在成都称帝，国号大蜀，史称前蜀。
四川安定富庶，许多北方的官员和文人前来投奔，其中包括诗人韦庄，他后来做了王建的宰相。王建的陵墓至今仍保存在成都。
former-shu-founded.why: Former Shu kept Sichuan's culture alive during the collapse of the Tang, and its court was a centre of the new ci poetry.
former-shu-founded.why_zh: 前蜀在唐朝崩溃之际保存了四川的文化，它的宫廷也是新兴的词的创作中心。

story: In 907 a large Liang army besieged Luzhou, a key Jin stronghold in southeastern Shanxi, and surrounded it with a double ring of walls to keep relief out. The defenders held on for about a year. Early in 908 the Jin ruler Li Keyong died, and his son Li Cunxu, only about twenty-three, took over.

The Liang commanders assumed Jin would be in mourning and confusion. Instead Li Cunxu marched south in secret with his general Zhou Dewei. At dawn, hidden by a heavy fog, his troops attacked the siege walls at Sanchuigang and broke through. The Liang army collapsed, losing thousands of men and huge stores.
Hearing the news, Zhu Wen is said to have sighed in admiration at Li Keyong's son.
story_zh: 907年，后梁大军包围了晋国在晋东南的重镇潞州，还修筑了内外两重夹城，阻止援军进入。守军坚持了约一年。908年初，晋王李克用去世，年仅二十三岁左右的儿子李存勖继位。
后梁将领以为晋国正在办丧事、人心不稳。李存勖却和大将周德威秘密率军南下，趁着清晨大雾在三垂冈一带突袭夹城，一举攻破。后梁军全线崩溃，损失数以千计的士兵和大量物资。
据说朱温听到消息后，对李克用这个儿子赞叹不已。
battle-of-luzhou.why: The victory secured Jin's survival and made Li Cunxu's name; fifteen years later he destroyed the Liang.
battle-of-luzhou.why_zh: 这一仗保住了晋国，也让李存勖一战成名；十五年后，他灭亡了后梁。

quote.zh: 生子当如李亚子，克用为不亡矣！
quote.en: A man should have a son like Li Yazi! Li Keyong lives on in him!
quote.from: Zhu Wen, recorded in the Zizhi Tongjian 朱温语，见《资治通鉴》

story: The ci was a new kind of poem, written to fit the tunes of popular songs, often sung by entertainers at banquets. In Later Shu, the official Zhao Chongzuo collected 500 such lyrics by eighteen poets, and the court writer Ouyang Jiong added a preface dated 940. The title means 'Among the Flowers'.

The anthology begins with Wen Tingyun, a late Tang poet, and also has many lyrics by Wei Zhuang and by poets of the Shu court. Most of its songs are about love, longing and the lives of women in beautiful gardens and chambers, written in rich, delicate language.
Later critics sometimes found it too sweet, but it set the style that ci writers followed for generations.
story_zh: 词是一种新兴的诗体，依照流行乐曲的曲调填写，常在宴席上由歌伎演唱。后蜀官员赵崇祚收集了十八位词人的五百首词，宫廷文人欧阳炯为之作序，序文写于940年。书名意为“花丛之中”。
集中第一位词人是晚唐的温庭筠，韦庄和后蜀宫廷词人的作品也收了很多。大部分作品描写爱情、相思以及深闺庭院中女子的生活，辞藻华美细腻。
后世评论家有时嫌它过于绮丽，但它奠定的风格影响了此后好几代词人。
huajian-ji.why: As the oldest surviving ci anthology, it marks the moment the form became serious literature, leading to the great Song lyricists.
huajian-ji.why_zh: 作为现存最早的词集，它标志着词正式成为文人文学，为宋代词的鼎盛开辟了道路。

story: With Southern Tang subdued, Chai Rong turned north in the spring of 959 to win back the Sixteen Prefectures that Shi Jingtang had given the Liao. He led the army himself, using boats along the rivers and canals of Hebei.

The campaign went faster than anyone expected. Within about forty-two days the Liao garrisons at Yijin Pass, Wakou Pass and Yuqiao Pass, and the prefectures of Ningzhou, Mozhou and Yingzhou, surrendered, mostly without a fight. Chai Rong planned to march on Youzhou (Beijing) next.
Then he fell seriously ill and had to return to Kaifeng. He died that summer, aged thirty-eight, leaving a six-year-old son on the throne. Six months later Zhao Kuangyin seized power.
story_zh: 南唐臣服后，柴荣于959年春挥师北上，要收复石敬瑭割给辽朝的燕云十六州。他御驾亲征，利用河北的河道和运河以舟船运兵。
战事进展之快出乎所有人意料。大约四十二天里，辽朝在益津关、瓦桥关、淤口关的守军以及宁州、莫州、瀛州相继投降，大多兵不血刃。柴荣计划下一步进攻幽州（今北京）。
这时他突然病重，只得返回开封，这年夏天去世，年仅三十八岁，留下一个六七岁的儿子继位。半年后，赵匡胤夺取了政权。
shizong-northern-campaign.why: These were the only lasting gains in the Sixteen Prefectures before the Ming, and the new line became the Song–Liao border.
shizong-northern-campaign.why_zh: 这是明朝以前中原王朝在燕云故地唯一持久的收复成果，由此形成的边界后来成为宋辽边界。
